descriptionHtml:
Approach · TC-21 Hospital vs. Nursing-Home Context Switch · S05 Badge × context → pre-selected template

UAT steps / ticket ACs covered:

  • U4 Default template: the admission-status badge pre-selects the template (New Admission → H&P / SNF admission, Follow-up → SOAP progress / SNF follow-up, Consult → Consult note / SNF consult), and the p … (UAT TC-21; UAT TC-21 step 1 (default template); TFA-92599 AC 6; TFA-92599 rule 4; TFA-92584 AC 6) — gate: blocked: TFA-92599 in progress

Test design technique: Decision table (decision-table) — List the combinations of several conditions and check each one, to see that the result follows the rule.

Given One Hospital patient and one Nursing Home resident

When Set the admission-status badge to New Admission, then Follow-up, then Consult, opening the generation step each time without touching the picker, in both contexts

Then Hospital: H&P / SOAP progress / Consult note is pre-selected. Nursing Home: SNF admission / SNF follow-up / SNF consult is pre-selected. The picker stays changeable (S06 changes it by hand).

Pass rule (oracle, excerpt): A native select lists every option even when closed, so the evidence is which option line carries [selected], for both the 'Admission status' badge and the 'Note Format' picker. The badge is quoted (`option "Consult" [selected]`), which keeps it distinct from 'Consult note' and makes a run that never changed the badge fail instead of passing on the Follow-up default. …

Where it ran: dev; test method AGENT · Browser agent; lane planned in the matrix: browser agent (automated)

S05 is our own case number (its number in the coverage matrix cases/TC-21.matrix.json), not a step number of the UAT document.

Environment: dev — dev deployment, build 43c38a4 (Deploy Convex, 2026-10-14T21:30:04Z); account and address are not written into the report; run folder runs/2026-10-14-dev.

Test method: AGENT · Browser agent; secondary: CODEREVIEW · Code review — as classified in cases/test-methods.json, which says it runs on both; Source: dev.
